about: Available for the first time on PS4, Trackmania offers you the ultimate arcade racing universe.
Test your skills and challenge your friends at home or online.
- Rollercoaster Lagoon: Defy gravity on magnetic tracks in a tropical paradise, - International Stadium: Use your driving skills to master this worldwide competition.
- Canyon Grand Drift: Drift through narrow tracks in this red canyon landscape.
- Down & Dirty Valley: Use air control and jump through this countryside setting.
